claim: Abhayagiri was not simply a second Theravada monastery parallel to the Mahavihara: Sri Lankan sectarian sources and modern critical scholarship associate its Dhammaruci community with Vaitulya/Vetulla currents, while Chinese and other evidence show a broader doctrinal range than the later Mahavihara-centred historical narrative alone suggests.
bounded_by: The label Vaitulya in polemical chronicles cannot be equated mechanically with a single, stable Mahayana sect; the claim is about documented doctrinal plurality and contestation at Abhayagiri.
notes: Directly extends C-R16-ABH-DATE-001: the new bronze dating question does not establish the older Mahayana/Vajrayana history, but the history itself has independent textual/scholarly support.
